title: adam Slice Status Registry (machine-readable companion)
description: Optional machine-readable mirror of agent-control/slice-status.md. The markdown registry stays the canonical, human-owned Tier-1 working memory; this JSON is a queryable companion that MUST agree with it row-for-row. Modeled on the ecc.session.v1 worker snapshot, in adam terms. The same 'one driver per registry' rule applies: only the Tier-1 orchestrator (orchestrate-build) writes it during a run.

schema_version.description: Compatibility gate. Consumers MUST branch on this. Bump to v2 only on a breaking change (removed/renamed/retyped field).

generated_at.description: When this snapshot was last written by the orchestrator.

run.description: Orchestration run id this snapshot belongs to, e.g. run-007. Null outside a bounded cycle.

slices.description: One entry per slice, in dependency order so a top-to-bottom read is a topological walk (mirrors the markdown row order).

aggregates.description: Derived counts for cheap status reads. statuses map MUST be consistent with slices[].status.

statuses.description: Count map keyed by status value.

id.description: Slice id; matches slices/<id>/ and the markdown row.

depends_on.description: Slice ids this slice waits on. Empty array = no unresolved edges (eligible for the next wave).

status.description: Lifecycle state. Mirrors agent-control/slice-status.md exactly. `done` only after the orchestrator independently re-ran the verifier and it exited 0.

health.description: Operational condition, distinct from lifecycle status. `stalled` = dispatched but no progress signal; `degraded` = progressing with warnings (e.g. verdict=warning).

branch.description: Branch the worker committed to (e.g. builder/<id>), or null before dispatch.

worktree.description: Worktree path when the slice runs in best-of-n-runner isolation, else null.

verify_exit.description: Exit code from the orchestrator's independent re-run of the slice verifier. 0 is the only value that justifies status=done. Null before any re-run.

verdict.description: Latest review gate for the slice from its run-result (review-via-graph / e2e). Null before review. A `block` keeps the slice off `done`.

operator_command.description: For status=human-gated: the exact command the operator must run before the verifier re-runs and the row can flip to done.

outputs.description: Structured outcomes for this slice. Empty arrays when unknown.

validation.description: Validation evidence (verifier, tests, review notes, screenshots).

remaining_risks.description: Open risks, follow-ups, or deferred debt.

run_result_ref.description: Path to the slice's structured run-result, e.g. scratch/run-results/<id>.json, for detail beyond this snapshot.

notes.description: One-phrase note mirroring the markdown notes column. Link out for anything longer.

updated_at.description: When this slice row was last changed.
